description: This file defines the QuickLaunchDao class within the OrangeHRM project, responsible for managing quick launch shortcut lists for modules like 'leave' and 'time', tailored for different user roles (Admin and ESS). It provides methods to retrieve active shortcuts based on module status and configuration settings.

classes.name: QuickLaunchDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for retrieving quick launch shortcuts based on module status and configuration in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getQuickLaunchList
methods.description: Returns a list of quick launch shortcuts for administrative users based on active modules and configurations.

methods.name: getQuickLaunchListForESS
methods.description: Returns a list of quick launch shortcuts for Employee Self Service (ESS) users based on active modules and configurations.

methods.name: getActiveQuickLaunchModuleList
methods.description: Private method that fetches a list of active modules ('leave' and 'time') which are enabled and configured.
